question: What is the maximum speed when towing a vehicle?
explanation: The towing speed must not be more than 25 km/h.

en.question: What is the maximum speed when towing a vehicle?
en.explanation: The towing speed must not be more than 25 km/h.

hi.question: खींचने वाले और खींचे जाने वाले वाहन के बीच की दूरी इससे अधिक नहीं होनी चाहिए:

question: A load carried on a vehicle must be:
options: Hanging as far out as possible
Secured so that it cannot slip, fall or roll, even on sudden braking
Left loose to keep the vehicle balanced

Be clear, readable and show only the registration number
Be removed when the vehicle is parked

hi.question: सार्वजनिक सेवा वाहन (जैसे बस) विस्फोटक या अत्यधिक ज्वलनशील सामान ले जा सकता है:

To see the passengers on the back seat

explanation: The hand brake holds a stopped vehicle in place, so it is meant for parking. Use the foot brake to slow down or stop.

question: What should you check before starting the engine of a vehicle?
options: The radiator water level and the engine oil level
explanation: Running an engine with too little coolant or oil can damage it badly, so check both levels before you start.

options: The radiator water level and the engine oil level

question: What can cause hard steering?
explanation: A tyre with too little air has a bigger area touching the road, which makes the steering feel heavy and hard to turn.

en.question: What can cause hard steering?

hi.question: स्टीयरिंग भारी होने का कारण क्या हो सकता है?

hi.explanation: कम हवा वाले टायर का सड़क से छूने वाला हिस्सा बड़ा हो जाता है, जिससे स्टीयरिंग भारी लगता है और मोड़ना कठिन हो जाता है।

question: An anti-lock braking system (ABS) stops the wheels from locking. What does this help the tyres to avoid?

en.question: An anti-lock braking system (ABS) stops the wheels from locking. What does this help the tyres to avoid?

question: Why is the rear view mirror slightly curved?

To cover the blind spot completely
To judge the speed of the vehicle behind

question: What is a blind spot?
options: An area that you cannot see in your mirrors
An area not lit by the headlights
An area not covered by the inside rear view mirror
explanation: A blind spot is a part of the road around your vehicle that your mirrors do not show, so you must turn your head to check it.

en.question: What is a blind spot?

question: What is an anti-lock braking system (ABS) designed to do?
options: Stop the driving wheels from spinning
Stop moisture building up inside the braking system
Stop the wheels from locking up when braking and avoid skidding
explanation: ABS releases and applies the brakes very quickly so the wheels do not lock, and the vehicle does not skid.

en.question: What is an anti-lock braking system (ABS) designed to do?

question: What is brake fade?
explanation: Brakes that get very hot, for example on a long descent, lose their grip and stop the vehicle less well. This is brake fade.

en.question: What is brake fade?

hi.question: ब्रेक फ़ेड क्या है?

question: How can you prevent brake fade while going downhill?
options: Select neutral for a short distance
Pump the brake pedal again and again
Select a suitable low gear and use the brakes only when necessary

hi.question: ढलान पर उतरते समय ब्रेक फ़ेड से कैसे बच सकते हैं?
